Requirement.description: A need for a component that purchasing must source; the root of a sourcing case.

Supplier.description: A company that supplies components; it may be on the blocked list.

Offer.description: A supplier's offer against a requirement, with price, lead time and contractual conditions.

PurchaseOrder.description: The commitment to a supplier; approval is required when its amount exceeds the buyer's approval limit.

record_offer.description: Record an offer received from a supplier against the requirement.

compare_offers.description: Compare the collected offers on price, lead time and contractual conditions.

negotiate_offer.description: Negotiate with the supplier of a preferred offer.

select_offer.description: Select the negotiated offer to commit to.

draft_purchase_order.description: Prepare a purchase order from the accepted offer for a supplier that is not blocked.

request_po_approval.description: Send a purchase order above the buyer's approval limit to the head of purchasing.

approve_purchase_order.description: The head of purchasing approves a purchase order above the buyer's limit.

place_purchase_order.description: Send the purchase order to the supplier, committing the company.
requires: Supplier.status == 'active' and ((PurchaseOrder.status == 'draft' and PurchaseOrder.amount <= PurchaseOrder.buyer_approval_limit) or PurchaseOrder.status == 'approved')

rules.description: A purchase order must never be placed with a supplier on the blocked list.
No purchase order is prepared for a blocked supplier.
Purchase orders above the buyer's approval limit are reviewed by the head of purchasing.
Above the approval limit, approval must precede placing the order.
Offers are compared before a purchase order is drafted.
Only the head of purchasing may approve purchase orders.
Buyers place purchase orders.
Only the head of purchasing may set the approval limit on an order.

requirement_committed.description: The requirement is committed through a placed purchase order.

Shipment.description: An international shipment coordinated for a customer, with a promised delivery deadline.

Customer.description: The party for whom shipments are coordinated and who must agree to air freight.

Carrier.description: A transport company that carries shipments and reports disruptions.

Disruption.description: A carrier-reported event affecting a shipment, such as a port closure or a missed sailing.

ReroutingDecision.description: The chosen new routing for a disrupted shipment: keep the carrier, switch carrier, or air.

record_disruption.description: Record a disruption reported by a carrier against a shipment.

assess_deadline_risk.description: Work out whether the promised delivery deadline is at risk given the disruption.

propose_rerouting.description: Propose a new routing (keep carrier, switch carrier, or air) with cost and new arrival estimate.

request_customer_air_agreement.description: Ask the customer to agree to moving the cargo by air freight.
requires: ReroutingDecision.status == 'proposed' and ReroutingDecision.option == 'air' and Shipment.dangerous_goods == False

record_customer_agreement.description: Record that the customer agreed to air freight.

record_customer_decline.description: Record that the customer declined air freight, so another option must be proposed.

approve_rerouting.description: A person approves the proposed rerouting before it is executed.
requires: (ReroutingDecision.status == 'proposed' and ReroutingDecision.option != 'air') or (ReroutingDecision.status == 'customer_agreed' and Shipment.dangerous_goods == False)

reject_rerouting.description: A person rejects a proposed rerouting.

execute_rerouting.description: Book the approved new routing with the carrier or air freight provider.
requires: ReroutingDecision.status == 'approved' and (ReroutingDecision.option != 'air' or (ReroutingDecision.customer_agreed == True and Shipment.dangerous_goods == False))

confirm_delivery.description: Record that the shipment has been delivered.

rules.description: Dangerous goods may never be moved by air.
Do not offer air freight to the customer for dangerous goods.
The customer's agreement must be recorded before an air rerouting is approved.
Deadline risk must be assessed before a new routing is proposed.
A person reviews every rerouting approval, because it commits money (air freight is expensive and costs may be charged to the customer) and no spending limit is stated.
Only operations coordinators may execute a rerouting booking.
Rerouting cost estimates are visible to operations coordinators and account managers.
Only operations coordinators may change the dangerous-goods flag.

delivered_by_deadline.description: The shipment is delivered no later than its promised deadline.

disruption_resolved.description: A reported disruption ends with an executed rerouting.

Site.description: One of the three hospital sites that host operating theatres, beds and shared equipment.

Resource.description: A schedulable resource at a site: an operating theatre, a bed or a shared piece of equipment such as an MRI scanner.

Booking.description: A booked procedure slot on a resource at a site. It records only scheduling data, never diagnosis or treatment decisions.

MaintenanceWindow.description: A planned maintenance period for a resource.

report_equipment_failure.description: Record that a resource (for example an MRI scanner) has failed.

report_theatre_overrun.description: Record that a theatre is overrunning its booked time.

flag_booking_disrupted.description: Mark a scheduled booking as disrupted because its resource failed, overran or entered maintenance.

propose_new_slot.description: Propose another slot at the same site for a disrupted booking.

propose_site_transfer.description: Propose moving a disrupted booking to another site. The move is pending the responsible clinician's agreement.

record_clinician_agreement.description: The responsible clinician records agreement to move the booked procedure to the proposed site. This is a human action and is never automated.

confirm_reschedule.description: Confirm the proposed new slot or site for the booking.
requires: Booking.status == 'reschedule_proposed' and (Booking.proposed_site_code == Booking.original_site_code or Booking.clinician_agreed == True)

notify_teams.description: Tell the affected clinical and theatre teams about the rescheduled booking.

start_maintenance.description: Begin a planned maintenance window and take the resource out of service.

complete_maintenance.description: Finish maintenance and return the resource to service.

rules.description: When a booking moves to another site, the responsible clinician's agreement must be recorded before the reschedule is confirmed.
Only the responsible clinician may record agreement to a site move.
Rescheduling an urgent procedure is reviewed by the responsible clinician before confirmation.
Maintenance may not start on a resource while an urgent booking on it is scheduled.
Only clinicians may set or change whether a procedure is urgent.
Schedulers confirm reschedules.
Only maintenance coordinators start maintenance windows.

disrupted_booking_resolved.description: A disrupted booking is rescheduled and the teams are informed, or the procedure is completed.

Claim.description: A property insurance claim submitted by a policyholder, from submission to decision.

Policy.description: The insurance policy a claim is checked against for eligibility.

ClaimDocument.description: A document submitted with a claim (photo, repair estimate, proof of ownership).

verify_documents.description: Confirm the required documents (photos, repair estimate, proof of ownership) are present, or that an exception has been granted, so the claim can be assessed.
requires: Claim.status == 'submitted' and ((Claim.photos_received == True and Claim.estimate_received == True and Claim.ownership_proof_received == True) or Claim.document_exception_granted == True)

grant_document_exception.description: Grant an exception allowing a claim to proceed without all the required documents.

mark_eligible.description: Adjuster records that the claim is eligible under the policy.

mark_ineligible.description: Adjuster records that the claim is not eligible under the policy.

refer_to_investigation.description: Flag suspected fraud and send the claim to the investigation unit.

clear_investigation.description: The investigation unit finds no fraud and returns the claim for settlement.

reject_for_fraud.description: The investigation unit confirms fraud and the claim is rejected.

settle_claim_automatically.description: Settle a small, eligible, non-suspicious claim without human intervention.
requires: Claim.status == 'eligible' and Claim.within_auto_settlement_limit == True and Claim.above_authority_limit == False and Claim.fraud_suspected == False

approve_settlement.description: An adjuster or senior adjuster approves settlement of an eligible claim that is not settled automatically.

reject_claim.description: Reject a claim found ineligible under the policy.

rules.description: Documents must be verified (or an exception granted) before eligibility is assessed.
Documents must be verified (or an exception granted) before a claim is assessed as ineligible.
Settling a claim above the authority limit requires review by a senior adjuster.
Automatic settlement is forbidden for claims above the authority limit, outside the small-claim limit, or suspected of fraud.
rules.when: Claim.above_authority_limit == True or Claim.within_auto_settlement_limit == False or Claim.fraud_suspected == True

rules.description: No manual settlement while fraud is suspected.
A person must approve any exception to the document rule.
Rejecting an ineligible claim is decided by an adjuster, not autonomously.
Rejection for fraud is decided by the investigation unit.
Only adjusters and senior adjusters assess eligibility.
Only adjusters and senior adjusters record ineligibility.
Only the investigation unit concludes investigations.
Only adjusters, senior adjusters and investigators can change the fraud flag.

claim_decided.description: Every claim reaches a decision: settled or rejected, within the committed deadline (5 or 10 working days, unresolved).
